title: Assembly manifest (schemaVersion 1)
description: BOM + executable interface contracts. mm, z-up. A node's interfaces connect its DIRECT children; endpoint strings are "<childId>.<datumName>". The root is the assembly. Distinct from `type` on an interface (the fit kind, e.g. 转动副): the node discriminator is `kind`.

transform.description: world = translate ∘ rotate(euler XYZ) ∘ pose; all in the part's local frame.

rotate.description: degrees; R = Rz(z)·Ry(y)·Rx(x), the OpenSCAD/Manifold rotate([x,y,z]) composition (three.js order 'ZYX'; its default 'XYZ' is the reverse order)

pose.description: Rotation about a named datum axis (assembly/meshing pose); the datum follows the part.

id.description: unique within the owning node, e.g. "I1"

a.description: "<direct child id>.<datum name>"; a dot, not ':' or '/'

type.description: fit kind; drives the default operator/layer

severity.description: hard = engine error; intent = human flag

check.description: Explicit operator; overrides the one derived from type. Implemented: distance, diameter-match, coaxial, motion-clearance, spring-preload, spring-behaviour, snap-fit. An unknown operator is not a schema error — it comes back skipped with its name.

params.description: distance: {distanceMm}; motion-clearance: {runId}; spring-preload: {freeLengthMm, stiffnessNPerMm}; spring-behaviour: use the `elastic` object; snap-fit: use the `elastic` snap-fit fields

elastic.description: General elastic-behaviour declaration; takes precedence over the legacy numeric `params` bag. spring-behaviour dispatches on behavior; unimplemented behaviors are skipped by name. Thresholds (forceBudgetN/requiredTravelMm) are USER-DECLARED acceptance criteria: the venue compares against them, it does not invent child/adult or product thresholds.

standardId.description: Optional seed-catalog id; fills only fields not declared explicitly. Unknown ids are a validation error. Currently axial-spring standard parts only.

direction.description: Omitted = report the deflection sign, do not enforce.

freeLengthMm.description: Free (unloaded) length along the a→b line, mm.

solidHeightMm.description: Coils-touching height, mm. Omit if unknown.

outerDiameterMm.description: Only for a slenderness ATTENTION, never a hard fail.

guided.description: Guided compression spring: suppresses the slenderness attention.

forceBudgetN.description: USER-DECLARED max absolute force, N. No value = no acceptance judgement.

stiffnessTolerancePct.description: Display-band half-width on k, percent; 0/absent = no k band.

lobeCount.description: snap-fit: number of elastic lobes (1 = single cantilever).

lobeWidthMm.description: snap-fit: width of one lobe at its root, mm.

lobeThicknessMm.description: snap-fit: wall thickness of the lobe, mm.

radialInterferenceMm.description: snap-fit: radial interference at the bead/undercut, mm.

youngModulusMPa.description: snap-fit: Young's modulus, MPa (beam force; strain does not need it).

leadAngleDeg.description: snap-fit: lead/insertion face angle from the insertion axis, degrees.

frictionCoeff.description: snap-fit: coefficient of friction on the lead face.

retentionAngleDeg.description: snap-fit: same wedge model for the retention face; default = leadAngleDeg.

maxStrainPct.description: snap-fit: USER-DECLARED allowable root strain, percent.

retentionLoadN.description: snap-fit: USER-DECLARED required retention load, N.

source.description: Where k / E came from; reported, not judged.

part.description: accepted alias for a part's display name (ignored by the checker)

version.description: part only: version id in the store

group.description: Functional group (功能区) this part belongs to, e.g. "底座组". At most ONE group per part; a small part (screw, nut, pin) may have none. Groups are a PARTITION OF PARTS, not a spatial region: a group's envelope is computed as the union of its members' bounding boxes. Budgets attach to groups (see assembly/budget.json), never to parts.

role.description: Appearance ownership. Default when omitted: source=stock -> purchased, otherwise printed. `reference` = vendor geometry kept for fit checking only: it occludes in the scene but is never judged, because you cannot change it.

interfaces.description: contracts between this node's DIRECT children
